description: Use this for a quick yes/no: can players on two different platforms play this game together online? Returns crossplay true or false plus the game page url. Returns false with a reason if the game is not on both platforms. PS4 with PS5, Xbox One with Series and Switch with Switch 2 count as the same family, not crossplay. platform_a and platform_b must differ. For the full matrix of a game use get_game. Read-only.
name: crossplay_check
